speaker: davy_gannet
text: Six Spanish galleys, off the north coast of Cornwall. That is the week's news. I had it on the water.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: I have heard four. I believe four as much as I believe six, which is not enough to spend a share on.

speaker: james_burbage
text: A coast is a large place. The man with the number is not in this boat. Pull.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not correcting it. Six has been said, and four has been said. I am not choosing a winner from a thwart.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Then the news has done what news does. I shout it. The timber is behind you.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Behind, and not under our feet. Home by the stair we came from.
